description: Defines the SpdyWriteQueue class and related functions for managing a priority queue of SPDY protocol frames to be written, including enqueue, dequeue, and removal operations.

classes.name: SpdyWriteQueue
classes.description: A class managing a priority queue of SPDY frames to be written, supporting enqueue, dequeue, and removal operations.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the write queue is empty.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds a frame producer to the queue with specified priority, type, stream, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Removes and retrieves the highest priority, earliest enqueued frame producer and its associated stream.

methods.name: RemovePendingWritesForStream
methods.description: Removes all pending writes for a specific stream.

methods.name: RemovePendingWritesForStreamsAfter
methods.description: Removes all pending writes for streams after a given stream ID.

methods.name: ChangePriorityOfWritesForStream
methods.description: Changes the priority of all pending writes for a specific stream.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all pending writes from the queue.

methods.name: num_queued_capped_frames
methods.description: Returns the number of capped frames currently queued.
